event: Hot-wallet anomaly: outflow > €500k or > 1% of float in 1h
action: Pause withdrawals; alert Head of Custody, MLRO, CISO; trigger incident-response runbook.
Freeze wallet; notify MLRO; file required regulatory report; assess unwind path.

event: On-chain screening flags inbound from mixer / sanctioned address
action: Freeze credit; SAR/STR filing; investigate; consider account closure.
Notify NCA per MiCA Art. 9 reporting; root-cause; customer comms plan.

event: Listed token suspected rug-pull or smart-contract exploit
action: Halt trading on the pair; customer notification; coordinate with issuer; legal review.

event: Travel-rule receiver rejects an outbound for missing data
action: Freeze the transfer; remediate beneficiary data; review counterparty registry.
